mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.product_id, s.sku_code, s.name, s.size_value, s.quantity, s.cost_price, s.sale_price, s.weight, s.volume, s.image, s.status, s.created_at, s.updated_at, COALESCE(inv.available_qty, 0) AS available_qty, COALESCE(inv.locked_qty, 0) AS locked_qty, COALESCE(inv.total_qty, 0) AS total_qty FROM product_sku s LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sku_id, SUM(quantity) AS available_qty, SUM(locked_qty) AS locked_qty, SUM(quantity + locked_qty) AS total_qty FROM stock WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY sku_id ) inv ON inv.sku_id = s.id WHERE s.product_id = #{productId} AND s.deleted = 0 ORDER BY CAST(s.size_value AS UNSIGNED), s.size_value, s.id ASC
SELECT id, product_id, sku_code, name, size_value, quantity, cost_price, sale_price, weight, volume, image, status, created_at, updated_at FROM product_sku WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT id, product_id, sku_code, name, size_value, quantity, cost_price, sale_price, weight, volume, image, status, created_at, updated_at FROM product_sku WHERE sku_code = #{skuCode} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_sku (product_id, sku_code, name, size_value, quantity, cost_price, sale_price, weight, volume, image, status) VALUES (#{productId}, #{skuCode}, #{name}, #{sizeValue}, #{quantity}, #{costPrice}, #{salePrice}, #{weight}, #{volume}, #{image}, #{status})
